show.description: A powerful war drama inspired by true events, Kargil 1999 brings to life the courage, sacrifice, and brotherhood of Indian soldiers who fought against impossible odds. Set amidst the icy peaks and roaring guns, it’s a story of patriotism, pain, and the unbreakable spirit of those who chose the nation over everything.
